Figure 27 shows the results of the total receptor exposure summary portion of the microscale analysis. The results predict an increase in carbon monoxide concentrations as a result of building the Airport Spur, both in 1977 and 1990, at all receptor locations studied except receptor #C.
In 1977 or 1990 no significant difference in pollutant concentrations is predicted between the build and no build alternatives at each of the receptor locations. The calculations show that none of the 1-hour predicted concentrations indicate a violation of the 1-hour MAAQS since the 1977 highest hourly concentrations at receptor #6 were 11.67 ppm for the No Build and 19.45 ppm for the Build condition. The calculations shows that none of the 8-hour predicted concentrations indicate a violation of the 8-hour MAAQS since the 1977 highest hourly concentrations, at receptor #3 were 6.06 ppm for the Duild and 5.76 ppm for the No Suild conditions. (Receptor #5 almost the same).
